name: Ca loc nuong U Minh
summary: Cá lóc nướng is snakehead from the melaleuca water, grilled over straw or tram-wood charcoal. The national tourism page ranks nướng first, then sour soup, kho, and boiled.
origin: U Minh Hạ. The national tourism news page says the fish is best from the tenth lunar month through the first lunar month, when the forest water is highest. The next solar dates are check on arrival.
howToEat: Grill it. The local order on that page is nhất nướng, nhì nấu canh chua, tam kho, tứ luộc.
Eat it with rau cỏ the, bông súng, and đọt rau muống đồng.
where: U Minh Hạ. No restaurant is named. Check on arrival for a price.
seoTitle: Ca loc nuong — grilled snakehead from U Minh
seoDescription: Cá lóc nướng U Minh is snakehead grilled over straw or tram charcoal, best from the tenth lunar month through the first. Check the next solar dates on arrival.
